arms.bins: g0(x) + s restricted to the alive subcomponents with s in one bin, not clipped; edges (-0.1, -0.01, 0.01, 0.03, 0.1, 0.3) (reported)
arms.noclip_perm: g0(x) + s_perm, not clipped, the same draws
arms.shared_perm: clip(g0(x) + s_perm) at the trigger, s_perm = s's values permuted among each matrix's alive subcomponents (recruit.shuffled, seeds 0..19; dead stay 0)
arms.trig, shared, noclip: amendment 1's, repeated: the gate and the unshuffled references

blind_to: the shuffle keeps each matrix's values and their sum, so it cannot tell whether which matrix (layer, attention or MLP) gets how much matters; it also moves negative values onto subcomponents that are off at the trigger (clipped to no effect in shared_perm, a sign flip in noclip_perm), so noclip_perm is the harsher null; trigger position and held-out windows only

expected.W0_gates: with s = 0 every shuffled and binned pattern is g0 and recovers 0 exactly (amendment 1 checked noclip with s = 0); not rerun
expected.repeat: trig, shared, noclip equal amendment 1's to 1e-6 (amendment 1 repeated E18 exactly)

measurements.R_x: rho_x / rho_trig, rho = recovery (lo - L00) / (L01 - L00) on the held-out windows, as amendment 1
measurements.ratio: mean over the 20 draws of rho_perm, divided by the unshuffled rho of the same pattern (relative; = the ratio of the R's)
measurements.spread: sd, min and max of R_perm over the 20 draws: the null's noise floor

noise: the spread over the 20 draws (reported per state); E18's random null on S_on had max 0.007; seeds agree within 0.02 on the unshuffled R
